Measures same Viscoelastic properties as previous generation of Th romboelastography. 2. Should monitor Rapid, Comprehensive and accurate identification o f patients Haemostasis including Platelet function in Laboratory or at S ite of Care. 3. Simple, self- contained cartridge system for monitoring for Global H aemostasis (K/ KH/ R/ FFL) & Platelet function monitoring. 4. Automatically Loaded micro fluidic cartridge. 5. Small Footprint & Portable Unit. 6. Without any additional/ Extra Module or Software. 7. Test preparation without complex pipetting and mixing. 8. Smaller blood volume per test. 9. Vibration resistant, no leveling required. 10 Equipment should be compact, simple to use and does not require dedicated staff / Technician. 11. Equipment should be “Robust” self-monitoring quality control 1.

12. Result should be available within minutes. 13. Equipment should be European CE/ USFDA/ BIS approved. 14. Provides more information than routine coagulation tests. 15. Remote results viewing and device administration software. 16. Operating Pressure 0 to 2,000m (0 to 6,560ft) above sea level. 17. Equipment must be supplied along with at least 20 cartridges each of Global Haemostasis and Platelet mapping. 18. Company must provide warranty for 05 years and the CAMC rates for next 5 years. 19 Company must quote rate of all available test cartridge for future s upply up to 3 years.
